description: Files a suggestion or a defect report about **Umtri the product** — this MCP server, its tools, the app, the docs. This is NOT for issues in the user's own project: those are bugs on a ground (create_bug). Call this ONLY when the human explicitly asks to leave feedback ("건의해줘", "report this to Umtri"). Do not file feedback on your own initiative — an inbox filled by agents stops being read. kind: "bug" = something in Umtri is broken or wrong; "improvement" = a suggestion / wish (default). source: where it surfaced — the ground slug you were working in, the tool name that felt wrong, the screen. It is free text and is not validated, but it is what makes a report actionable later. One-way: this files the report, and there is no reading it back — do not promise the human a status thread. Requires a write-scope token.

body.description: Details — what you expected, what happened, why it matters (markdown allowed).

kind.description: "bug" for something broken in Umtri, "improvement" for a suggestion. Defaults to "improvement".

source.description: Where it came up: ground slug, tool name, or screen.

name: send_feedback
title: Send feedback about Umtri itself
